annual_rate.notes: Liquidated or contract claims may bear 9% under § 408.020. For qualifying tort claims, § 408.040.3 awards prejudgment interest within the subsection that sets the tort judgment rate at the intended Federal Funds Rate plus 5 points. Section 408.040.4 separately says the judgment for prejudgment interest bears Federal Funds plus 3 points after entry. Because those are distinct stages, this reference record does not flatten the tort rule into one headline percentage. Not legal advice.
